nodes.name: prepare
nodes.label: Validate request
nodes.description: Checks that an actual user message is present

nodes.name: planner
nodes.label: Plan tool use
nodes.description: IFM LLM creates an execution plan from the request

nodes.name: agent
nodes.label: Choose actions
nodes.description: IFM LLM selects structured actions; LangGraph executes the real tool calls

nodes.name: tools
nodes.label: Dispatch tools
nodes.description: Runs only requested tools; independent calls execute concurrently

nodes.name: lookup_product
nodes.label: lookup_product
nodes.description: Read a product's unit price (USD) and weight (kg) from the local demo catalog.

nodes.name: search_notes
nodes.label: search_notes
nodes.description: Search local demo store policy notes. Topics: shipping, discounts, currency.

nodes.name: calculator
nodes.label: calculator
nodes.description: Evaluate bounded numeric arithmetic: +, -, *, /, parentheses. No Python code or variables.

nodes.name: summarize_numbers
nodes.label: summarize_numbers
nodes.description: Return count, mean, minimum, maximum, and sum for up to 100 numeric values.

nodes.name: convert_units
nodes.label: convert_units
nodes.description: Convert mass between kg and g, or distance between km and m.

nodes.name: shipping_quote
nodes.label: shipping_quote
nodes.description: Quote demo shipping in USD: base $5 + $1.50/kg + $0.01/km.

nodes.name: apply_discount
nodes.label: apply_discount
nodes.description: Apply WELCOME10 to merchandise; return discounted subtotal and amount saved in USD.

nodes.name: format_report
nodes.label: format_report
nodes.description: Format a concise final purchase report from already verified observations. Returns text, writes no files.

nodes.name: review
nodes.label: Review observations
nodes.description: Counts actual tool responses and returns control to the LLM

nodes.name: verify
nodes.label: Validate answer
nodes.description: Returns the actual formatted tool report or checks the final message
